notablePrerequisites: Druid's Call attached to an indestructible creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Lightning Volley by paying {3}{R}.
Activate the creature with Druid's Call attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
